class NumberWordFormatter:
    # Replace Magic Number with Symbolic Constant
    GROUP_SIZE = 3
    # Replace Magic Number with Symbolic Constant
    MIN_GROUP_COUNT = 4
    # Replace Magic Number with Symbolic Constant
    TWO_DIGIT_MIN = 10
    # Replace Magic Number with Symbolic Constant
    HUNDREDS_MOD = 100
    # Replace Magic Number with Symbolic Constant
    ZERO_PAD_DIGITS = 2


    def __init__(self):
        # Self-Encapsulate Field / Replace Data Value with Object (conceptually, keep as immutable tuple)
        self.NUMBER = ("", "ONE", "TWO", "THREE", "FOUR", "FIVE", "SIX", "SEVEN", "EIGHT", "NINE")
        self.NUMBER_TEEN = ("TEN", "ELEVEN", "TWELVE", "THIRTEEN", "FOURTEEN", "FIFTEEN", "SIXTEEN", "SEVENTEEN",
                            "EIGHTEEN", "NINETEEN")
        self.NUMBER_TEN = ("TEN", "TWENTY", "THIRTY", "FORTY", "FIFTY", "SIXTY", "SEVENTY", "EIGHTY", "NINETY")
        self.NUMBER_MORE = ("", "THOUSAND", "MILLION", "BILLION")
        self.NUMBER_SUFFIX = ("k", "w", "", "m", "", "", "b", "", "", "t", "", "", "p", "", "", "e")

    def format(self, x):
        # Replace Nested Conditional with Guard Clauses
        if x is None:
            return ""
        return self.format_string(str(x))

    def format_string(self, x):
        # Split Temporary Variable / Extract Method for splitting
        lstr, rstr = self.split_integer_and_fractional(x)
        lstrrev = self.reverse_and_pad(lstr)

        # Extract Method: build the large number part
        lm = self.build_large_number(lstrrev)

        # Extract Method: build the cents part
        xs = self.build_cents_suffix(rstr)

        # Introduce Explaining Variable / Replace Nested Conditional with Guard Clauses
        if not lm.strip():
            return "ZERO ONLY"
        return f"{lm.strip()} {xs}ONLY"

    # Extract Method
    def split_integer_and_fractional(self, x):
        parts = x.split('.')
        # Ensure we have at least two parts
        integer_part = parts[0]
        fractional_part = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
        return integer_part, fractional_part

    # Extract Method
    def reverse_and_pad(self, lstr):
        lstrrev = lstr[::-1]
        mod = len(lstrrev) % self.GROUP_SIZE
        if mod == 1:
            lstrrev += "00"
        elif mod == 2:
            lstrrev += "0"
        return lstrrev

    # Extract Method
    def build_large_number(self, lstrrev):
        lm = ""
        group_count = len(lstrrev) // self.GROUP_SIZE
        for i in range(group_count):
            group = lstrrev[self.GROUP_SIZE * i:self.GROUP_SIZE * i + self.GROUP_SIZE][::-1]
            if group != "000":
                lm = self.trans_three(group) + " " + self.parse_more(i) + " " + lm
            else:
                lm += self.trans_three(group)
        return lm

    # Extract Method
    def build_cents_suffix(self, rstr):
        if rstr:
            return f"AND CENTS {self.trans_two(rstr)} "
        return ""

    def trans_two(self, s):
        # Self-Encapsulate Field (using constant)
        s = s.zfill(self.ZERO_PAD_DIGITS)
        first = s[0]
        last = s[-1]

        # Decompose Conditional / Replace Nested Conditional with Guard Clauses
        if first == "0":
            return self.NUMBER[int(last)]

        if first == "1":
            return self.NUMBER_TEEN[int(s) - self.TWO_DIGIT_MIN]

        tens_part = self.NUMBER_TEN[int(first) - 1]
        if last == "0":
            return tens_part
        return tens_part + " " + self.NUMBER[int(last)]

    def trans_three(self, s):
        hundreds_digit = s[0]
        rest = s[1:]

        # Decompose Conditional
        if hundreds_digit == "0":
            return self.trans_two(rest)

        if rest == "00":
            return f"{self.NUMBER[int(hundreds_digit)]} HUNDRED"

        return f"{self.NUMBER[int(hundreds_digit)]} HUNDRED AND {self.trans_two(rest)}"

    def parse_more(self, i):
        # Guard clause for safety? Original code assumes index is valid based on loop range.
        return self.NUMBER_MORE[i]
